derivation: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2191 (זְעֵיר)xlit zeʻêyr corrected to zᵉʻêyr

occurrences.text: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.
